NoTE: Boundary lines 3-4-5-6-7-8-9-10-11-MBM No. 27 are along
established boundary lines of the municipality of Gamu. Azimuths
and distances thereof are scaled. Line 3-4 is a portion of the bound-
ary line between Gamu and Isabela Estate. Lines 4-5-6-7-8 are the
boundary lines between Gamu and the sub-province of Ifugao. Lines
8-9-10-11-MBM No. 27 are portions of the boundary lines between
Gamu and Ilagan. Lines MBM No. 27-1-2-3 constitute the boundary
lines between the municipality of Roxas and the mother municipal-
ity. Points 1, 2 and 3. are wooden pegs properly tied te reference
points by azimuths and distances.
The municipality of Gamu shall consist of its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the area
above described.
The organization herein made shall take effect on July
1, 1948.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of May, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILio ABELLo
Executive Secietary
